method: Independent read-only supplementary audit of every current tooling test and native environment helper. Parsed TypeScript AST for all case definitions and assertion contracts, then read every complete test/helper body, with substantive review of audit evidence integrity, source-bound authorization, source/history redaction, CI case identity reconciliation, fail/skip semantics, native package integrity, isolated environments and fixture cleanup. Compared high-risk audit and authorization test contracts with complete current run-tests.mjs, snapshot.mjs and release-authorization.mjs bodies; reread install.py as deployment context. All inspected bytes checked against the frozen inventory and final snapshot(undefined,true) digest. No tests, services or mutation workflows executed.

coverage.definitionCounting: Callback-bearing test calls only; parameterized factories are excluded, and each tables and loops were read without claiming runtime-expanded counts.
